cases.script:
# GS-010: Salt can alter gas solubility without consuming the gas
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
seal v1 500mL
add v1 CO2 0.001mol
inspect v1
new
add v2 water 100mL
add v2 NaCl 0.1mol
seal v2 500mL
add v2 CO2 0.001mol
inspect v2
cases.original_forecast: Chemical expectation: a concentrated salt medium can reduce molecular CO2 solubility through salting-out; it does not stoichiometrically consume CO2.

original_criteria.criterion: Compare neutral dissolved CO2 separately from bicarbonate/carbonate and gas-phase carbon.
If the partition model lacks a salinity correction, record the missing effect as unsupported rather than forcing an expected difference.

changed_source_expectations.scope: Original qualitative salinity forecast plus a conserved represented C/H/O/Na/Cl/charge prerequisite; no empirical salinity calibration.

cases.script:
# KN-007: Recover and reuse manganese dioxide with a fresh substrate charge
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 MnO2 0.001mol
add v1 H2O2 0.001mol
wait 60s
inspect v1
new
filter v1 v2
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 H2O2 0.001mol
wait 60s
inspect
cases.original_forecast: The retained solid catalyst remains active when supplied with fresh solvent and peroxide.

original_criteria.criterion: The catalyst amount in v1 is not spent by the first reaction or created by reuse.
The second peroxide charge undergoes decomposition; do not equate rates unless temperature and retained-liquid conditions match.

changed_source_expectations.scope: Changed-source original-protocol replay only. Preserve the old oxygen-loss outcome and separate already integrated gas-retention tests.

cases.script:
# OR-006: Base-limited ester hydrolysis leaves residual ester
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 water 20mL
add v1 ethyl_acetate 0.01mol
add v1 NaOH 0.005mol
inspect v1
react v1 saponification
inspect v1
cases.original_forecast: The nominal hydroxide dose can hydrolyse at most half the ester through the saponification reaction, producing acetate and ethanol.

original_criteria.criterion: Ester remains after the available hydroxide-equivalent budget has been spent.
Any conversion must match formation of both acetate and ethanol; a pH change alone is insufficient.

changed_source_expectations.limiting_inventory: 0.005mol analytical hydroxide-equivalent budget, not rounded displayed OH activity or NaOH bottle identity
changed_source_expectations.scope: Explicit requested overall template, not cold/warm kinetic prediction or reaction heat.

cases.script:
# TH-016: A metal absorbs latent heat while melting without being oxidised
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 Zn 50g @ 400C
heat v1 1kJ
inspect v1
measure v1 thermometer
inspect
cases.original_forecast: The pulse can bring zinc to its melting region and partly melt it; a solid/liquid transition is not by itself a change in oxidation state.

original_criteria.criterion: Identify metallic zinc in both phases near its declared melting transition.
Any oxide formation must have its own oxygen source and reaction accounting; melting alone cannot create ZnO.

changed_source_expectations.property_binding: Actual deployed-source Zn solid heat-capacity curve and declared enthalpy of fusion; freeze those property-byte hashes at binding before issue. Compare latent+sensible energy and source boundary before numeric energy verdict.
changed_source_expectations.scope: Original finite partial-melt forecast and event/owned-phase consistency; no empirical calibration or full mixed-phase thermodynamics claim.
